Introduction
Build, deploy, and manage AI agents in a shared workspace.
Sim Chat with a release tracker table open beside it.
Start building
Start with Chat
Describe a task and build with Sim.
Use the workflow builder
Connect blocks, test each step, and deploy.
Build with the API
Create resources and run workflows from your application.
You can start in Chat and refine the same workflow in the builder. On self-hosted deployments, Chat depends on the deployment’s configuration and can be disabled.
Your workspace
A workspace holds the resources your team and agents use:
Resource
Purpose
Workflows
Executable logic made of connected blocks.
Tables
Structured rows that workflows can read and update.
Files
Documents and media shared with your agents.
Knowledge bases
Searchable documents for grounded answers.
Logs
Inputs, outputs, errors, timing, and costs.
Follow Getting started to build and run your first workflow.
Models and integrations
Find supported services in the integration catalog. Add them as workflow blocks or tools an Agent can call.

For tools outside the catalog, connect an external MCP server or create a custom tool. Configure the credentials and permissions each service requires.
Choose a deployment
Sim Cloud is the managed service. Self-hosted Sim runs on your infrastructure with Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

The core source is available under Apache 2.0. Enterprise features use a separate license that requires an active Enterprise subscription for production use.
